attackers_goals: An attacker might look for AD CS servers, certificate templates or request certificates. With the wrong setting or loose vulnerable templates or enabled enrollment, the attacker will be able to authenticate as users on the network.
description: A suspicious occurrence of Certutil attempted to contact the AD CS Request Interface.
investigative_actions: Look at further action done by the user. Investigate whether other non-standard operations were done regarding the AD CS.
name: Suspicious Certutil AD CS contact
